title: Customer support routing
after_prompt: Classify the support message into one allowed queue, return JSON, cite the phrase that supports the label, and use unknown when evidence is insufficient.

title: RAG policy answer
before_prompt: Answer the user's policy question using the provided documents.
after_prompt: Use only supplied policy excerpts, list supporting excerpt IDs first, answer in three bullets, and mark unsupported parts as not found in sources.
acceptance_criteria: Every claim maps to an excerpt ID.
Answer stays within the requested length.

title: Coding-agent repository change
before_prompt: Fix the bug and run tests.
after_prompt: Inspect the repository, identify the failing path, make the smallest code change, run targeted then full tests, and report exact files and commands.
acceptance_criteria: Repository state is inspected before editing.
Tests are named with pass or fail status.
